mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past 6 months indicates rising inflation expectations, leading to higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or 5-day forward returns in inflationary periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% decline in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, leading to higher wages and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) over the past 6 months indicates rising economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or 60-day forward returns in expansionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 1% increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past 3 months and a 0.5% decline in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months signal rising inflation expectations and a tightening labor market, leading to higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 1% in 3 months and UNRATE declines > 0.5% in 3 months
regime_hint: inflationary regime with labor market tightening
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or 20-day forward returns in inflationary periods with labor market tightening are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 1% decline in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) over the past 6 months and a 2% increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) over the past 6 months signal a tightening labor market and rising economic activity, leading to higher wages and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE declines > 1% in 6 months and INDPRO rises > 2% in 6 months
regime_hint: labor market tightening with expansionary regime
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods with expansionary regime are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% decline in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to lower interest rates and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only in periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2%).
regime_hint: monetary easing cycle with low inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods with low inflation are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
